messages.subject: coloring edges/segments in ggdendro-plots
parts:
Is it possible to colour the edges of ggdendrogram plot for a specific set of dendrogram nodes?

For example, consider the following dendrogram:

library(ggplot2)
library(ggdendrogram)
hc <- hclust(dist(USArrests), "ave")
dhc <- as.dendrogram(hc)
ddata <- dendro_data(dhc, type="rectangle")
p <- ggplot(segment(ddata)) +geom_segment(aes(x=x, y=y, xend=xend, yend=yend))
print(p)

Now suppose I want to make all the edgjes/segment lines that belong to the left part of the dendrogram red, how can I do that?

colorLeafs <- labels(dhc[[1]])
Can I make exactly the same dendrogram with the leafs in colorLeafs coloured "red"?

Many thanks in advance!

Irsan
